data.narrative:
Onodrim Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Aistis Šimaitis, Alexander Blessing, and Christian Garrett, having raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public companies in the same sector and stage cohort, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €40M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x, implying a $100M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed stage, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A) yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $85M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $250M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding stage-appropriate valuation intensity within Defense & Security. Key variables include the company's capital efficiency relative to peer burn rates, differentiation of technology versus crowded sector dynamics, and customer concentration risk. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods suggests that comparable companies command significant premiums; justifying valuations above $100M would require demonstrating defensible technical or commercial advantages relative to the peer set.
